'''Regel Eight''' was a location<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> in the [[Regel system/Legends|eponymous star system]] from the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Regel Eight was visited by [[Jae Juun]] and his co-pilot [[Tarfang]] in the [[XR808g|their ship]] before they embarked on a flight to the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]].<ref name="JK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Regel Eight was first mentioned in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="JK" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Regel system/Legends|Regel star system]] and the location itself in grid square I-7.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
